title: RFWeave: Generalizable Wireless Propagation Prediction Across Scenes and Transceiver Configurations
abstract: arXiv:2610.16656v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Wireless propagation modeling is foundational to the evaluation and design of modern communication systems. While recent learning-based methods have shown promising generalization across transceiver positions and unseen scenes, they remain largely confined to a fixed configuration of array size, receiver orientation, and transmit beam. In this work, we introduce RFWeave, a unified feedforward model for wireless propagation prediction across scenes, transceiver positions, and transceiver configurations. Its core innovation is a flexible antenna representation that accommodates varying array structures while capturing spatial relations between transmitter and receiver elements. Our conditioning mechanism allows the model to use a shared Transformer backbone across diverse transceiver configurations, enabling joint prediction of received power and the angle-of-arrival spatial spectrum. translated_title: RFWeave：跨场景与收发机配置的可泛化无线传播预测
translated_abstract: 无线传播建模是现代通信系统评估与设计的基础。尽管近期的基于学习的方法在收发机位置和未见场景上已展现出良好的泛化能力，但它们在很大程度上仍局限于固定的阵列尺寸、接收机朝向和发射波束配置。在本工作中，我们提出了RFWeave，一个能够在场景、收发机位置和收发机配置之间进行无线传播预测的统一前馈模型。其核心创新是一种灵活的天线表示方法，既能适应不同的阵列结构，又能捕捉发射机与接收机阵元之间的空间关系。我们的条件化机制使模型能够在多样的收发机配置下共享同一个Transformer骨干网络，从而实现接收功率与到达角空间谱的联合预测。该模型在大规模模拟数据集上训练……
tldr: RFWeave通过灵活的天线表示与条件化机制，构建了一个统一的前馈模型，首次实现了跨场景、跨收发机位置以及跨收发机配置（阵列尺寸、接收朝向、发射波束）的无线传播预测，并能联合预测接收功率与到达角空间谱。
en_tdlr: RFWeave introduces a unified feedforward model with a flexible antenna representation and conditioning mechanism, enabling generalizable wireless propagation prediction across scenes, transceiver positions, and configurations, with joint prediction of received power and angle-of-arrival spatial spectrum.
